name: Pomerium
description: Pomerium - Secure, identity-aware access from anywhere.

paths.name: Pomerium config
paths.description: Pomerium config.yaml file. Mostly defines routes and authorizations but also anything else not available through this template

variables.name: Debug
variables.description: Debug enables colored, human-readable logs to be streamed to standard out (opens new window). In production, it is recommended to be set to false.

variables.name: Address
variables.description: Address specifies the host and port to serve HTTP requests from.

variables.name: Insecure
variables.description: Turning on insecure server mode will result in pomerium starting, and operating without any protocol encryption in transit. This setting can be useful in a situation where you have Pomerium behind a TLS terminating ingress or proxy. However, even in that case, it is highly recommended to use TLS to protect the confidentiality and integrity of service communication even behind the ingress using self-signed certificates or an internal CA. Please see our helm-chart for an example of just that.

variables.name: Trusted Reverse Proxy Hops
variables.description: Number of trusted reverse proxy hops in front of Pomerium. Set to 1 when Nginx Proxy Manager connects directly to this container so Pomerium trusts the original HTTPS scheme. Keep Pomerium reachable only through that trusted proxy.

variables.name: Authenticate Service URL
variables.description: Authenticate Service URL is the externally accessible URL for the authenticate service.

variables.name: Cookie Secret
variables.description: Secret used to encrypt and sign session cookies. You can generate a random key with head -c32 /dev/urandom | base64.

variables.name: Shared Secret
variables.description: Shared Secret is the base64 encoded 256-bit key used to mutually authenticate requests between services. It's critical that secret keys are random, and stored safely. Use a key management system or /dev/urandom to generate a key. Example head -c32 /dev/urandom | base64

variables.name: IDP Provider
variables.description: Provider is the short-hand name of a built-in OpenID Connect (oidc) identity provider to be used for authentication. To use a generic provider,set to oidc.

variables.name: Google Client Id
variables.description: Client ID is the OAuth 2.0 Client Identifier retrieved from your identity provider. See your identity provider's documentation, and our identity provider docs for details.

variables.name: Google Client Secret
variables.description: Client Secret is the OAuth 2.0 Secret Identifier retrieved from your identity provider. See your identity provider's documentation, and our identity provider docs for details.
